appearance_facts.fact: Blue solid line with circle markers represents '0-14 years (%)'.
Red dashed line with square markers represents '65 years + (%)'.
The blue line at the 2014 tick mark is labeled '14.82%'.
The red line at the 2014 tick mark is labeled '20.1%'.

public_definitions: Review the public population age-structure dashboard, compare the 2014 population share for 0-14 years and 65 years +, then open the age-group public services planning follow-up record for the group with the larger 2014 share.
